# grafana-adaptive-logs_exemption (Resource)

Manages an Adaptive Logs exemption: a LogQL stream selector whose matching logs are never dropped, regardless of drop rules or recommendations.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "grafana-adaptive-logs_exemption" "login_audit" {
  stream_selector = "{service_name=\"login\"}"
  reason          = "compliance audit trail - never drop"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `stream_selector` (String) A LogQL stream selector matching logs that should never be dropped.

### Optional

- `expires_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp after which this exemption no longer applies.
- `reason` (String) Business reason for this exemption.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the exemption was created.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the exemption, set by the server.
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp when the exemption was last updated.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import grafana-adaptive-logs_exemption.login_audit <exemption-id>
```
